snapshot_note: Rules that the Oncotarget and Aging instructions state word for word. Fees and scope differ: SubmitReady reads the journal's own page on every run.

csl_style.note: Impact Journals house style; check the journal page for the reference format.

requirements.rule: Manuscript as a Word file (doc or docx)
requirements.quote: Manuscript files: Word, WordPerfect (doc or docx).

Research papers should contain the following sections in this order: Title, Authors, Affiliations, Contact Information, Keywords (5), Abstract, Introduction, Results, Discussion, Methods or Materials and Methods, Abbreviations, Author Contributions, Acknowledgments, Conflicts of Interest, Funding, References.

requirements.rule: Sections in order: Abstract, Introduction, Results, Discussion, Methods, Abbreviations, Author Contributions, Acknowledgments, Conflicts of Interest, Funding, References
requirements.quote: Research papers should contain the following sections in this order: Title, Authors, Affiliations, Contact Information, Keywords (5), Abstract, Introduction, Results, Discussion, Methods or Materials and Methods, Abbreviations, Author Contributions, Acknowledgments, Conflicts of Interest, Funding, References.

requirements.rule: Conflict of interest statement, even if there are none
requirements.quote: The authors are responsible for providing a detailed conflict of interest statement on the title page of their submission, even if there are no conflicts to disclose.

requirements.rule: Ethical Statement for human or animal work; Consent for case reports and clinical papers
requirements.quote: Research papers involving animal work should contain the following section: Ethical Statement

requirements.rule: LLM use documented in the Methods
requirements.quote: Researchers must document the use of LLMs in the Methods section of their manuscripts, or in an appropriate alternative section if a Methods section is not available.

requirements.rule: No AI-generated images, with narrow exceptions
requirements.quote: While these issues are still being resolved, the use of AI-generated images and videos in publications is generally not permitted unless the images are obtained from agencies with whom we have contractual agreements and are created in a legally acceptable manner.

requirements.rule: Microarray data MIAME compliant and deposited
requirements.quote: Reports on microarray experiments should follow the MIAME guidelines published by the Functional Genomics Data Society (FGED), and the data from the experiments must be deposited in a publicly accessible database.

requirements.rule: Names, affiliations and real emails for all co-authors in the submission system
requirements.quote: In the submission system, please provide names, affiliations, and real emails for ALL co-authors.
